decisions.statement: The roots are the kinds of page that extend the service page type.
A kind reached only through another kind is a root of its own all the same.
A kind no page is of is left out rather than drawn empty.
A kind named for its runner is labelled by the runner alone.
A service hangs under the kind of page that service is.
The rows under one row are in alphabetical order.
A row's detail is the definition its own page states.
A service's color is the verdict published beside that service's page.
A service the last look found well is green.
A service the last look found broken is red.
A service carrying no verdict takes no color rather than a color meaning well.
A kind of service takes no color of its own.
A verdict is no fresher than the last look at the service it is about.
Every kind of service publishes whether that service is well.
The panel says whether the verdicts the panel draws are current.
Nothing here walks the file system.

definition: every service there is, gathered under the kind of service each one is
